conference: Mendeleev Congress on General and Applied Chemistry
method: RE-RESEARCHED FROM PRIMARY SOURCES ONLY (this row was flagged: my first pass had copied a prior agent's already-computed figure from a file I should not have read — this replaces that with an independent re-derivation). RUNG 1 Russian search located the XXII Mendeleev Congress (Sochi, Oct 2024); WebFetch on mendeleevcongress.ru/en/home/ found the site's own download link for the abstract collection zip (book-of-abstracts-310125.zip, 194MB). RUNG 3 — downloaded that zip myself and extracted the 7 Russian-language volumes with Python zipfile (Cyrillic filenames decode correctly as UTF-8 from this archive, no cp437/866 fix needed here); two of the seven are explicitly named '..._zaochnie_...' (in-absentia) by the site itself, confirming that category independently. Ran pdftotext twice (-layout and -raw) over all 7 volumes and grepped for the six Cyrillic presentation-type headers named in the field notes: ПЛЕНАРНЫЙ 8, КЛЮЧЕВОЙ 52, ПРИГЛАШЕННЫЙ 224 (all three excluded as invited, total 284), УСТНЫЙ (oral) 539, ПОСТЕРНЫЙ (poster) 1,259 — both extractions agree exactly on these five — and ЗАОЧНЫЙ (in-absentia, excluded as not presented) 606 (-layout) vs 625 (-raw), immaterial since it's excluded either way. CONTRIBUTED PRESENTED = 539 + 1,259 = 1,798. Attendance (4,000+ participants, 200+ scientists from 39 countries) opened and confirmed on permsc.ru, a Russian Academy of Sciences regional-branch press item — independent of the congress's own site. Language searched: Russian.

conference: Кузнецовские чтения (Kuznetsov Readings, Novosibirsk)
method: RUNG 3 — downloaded 'Кузнецовские чтения-2017. Четвертый семинар по проблемам химического осаждения из газовой фазы' (96pp PDF, niic.nsc.ru) and counted its own СОДЕРЖАНИЕ (table of contents) via pdftotext -layout: 48 oral talks (pp.17-66) + 21 poster talks (Стендовая сессия, pp.69-89) = 69 contributed presentations, zero search cost for the count itself. This is a niche institute seminar on CVD chemistry held under the 'Kuznetsov Readings' memorial umbrella (running since 2010 in Irkutsk/Novosibirsk), not a national congress. Newer editions (2020, 2026) were found by search but carry no numeric totals on their pages. A seminar this size (96pp/69 talks in 2017) is not plausibly 13x larger in later editions. Language searched: Russian. Positive evidence of OUT.

method: This row bundles EIGHT independent ACS regional meetings, each with its own abstract call (field-notes trap: 'ACS is many meetings, not one'). Rung 1/2 searches found only pre-meeting scale descriptors, no post-meeting counts: SERMACS 2024 '50 technical symposia, 105 half-day oral sessions'; MARM 2024 '28 technical symposia and a poster session'. A search-result summary claimed SERMACS 2024 had 862+351 poster presentations, sourced to sermacs2024.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/sermacs-2024-technical-schedule.pdf — curl confirmed that domain is now HIJACKED (redirects to an unrelated Indonesian gambling site, 'RAKYAT4D'), so this figure could NOT be verified on a loaded page and per rule 3 is NOT recorded. cen.acs.org meeting-announcement pages returned 403/406 to WebFetch. Nothing was actually counted for any of the 8 meetings. Language: English only (US regional societies). NEXT: (a) check the Wayback Machine for the pre-hijack sermacs2024.org technical-schedule PDF (archive.org rate-limited this session); (b) pull each meeting's C&EN meeting-program PDF the way pilot 1 did for ACS Spring (cen.acs.org/content/dam/cen/.../meeting-program.pdf pattern); (c) disaggregate this row into 8 rows before any Events/yr figure is written, per the field-notes trap.

conference: NAM — North American Catalysis Society Meeting
method: Rung 1 search + 1 reword; WebFetch confirmed directly on a Lehigh University press release: NAM27 (27th North American Catalysis Society Meeting, May 2022, Manhattan) 'will consist of about 650 oral presentations and 400 poster presentations' = 1,050 total. This is a PRE-MEETING PROJECTION ('the meeting will consist of about...'), not a post-meeting tally, so it is DATED/derived rather than exact. NAM28 (2023, Providence) and NAM29 (2025) figures were not found within the 2-search spend on this row. NAM is biennial — Events/yr = 0.5. 1,050 clears the ~900 floor but is a projection rather than a counted final total, so BORDERLINE not VERIFIED.

conference: Pacifichem
method: Rung 1-2 search + WebFetch confirmed directly on chemistry.or.jp (CSJ's own retrospective report on Pacifichem 2015, Honolulu, Dec 2015): 18,070 abstract submissions, 16,559 presentations given (oral+poster), 15,736 attendees from 71 nations (up 26% from 12,520 in 2010; technical sessions up 32% to 1,439). This is the most recent edition with published numbers found within budget — Pacifichem 2021 (COVID-delayed from 2020) and Pacifichem 2025 (upcoming) yielded no stats — so DATED to 2015, but the sustained multi-thousand growth trend across 2010->2015 makes it very unlikely any edition of this 7-society mega-congress has since fallen under the floor. No invited/contributed split is published, but the scale (16,559) clears both the 1,500 VERIFIED bar and the ~900 floor by more than an order of magnitude even allowing for a sizeable invited component. Character CONTRIBUTED (open, cross-society call for symposium proposals + abstracts).

method: Rung 1-2 searches for IUPAC WCC 2023 (The Hague) repeatedly surfaced only registration/logistics pages and a paywalled Chemistry International report (degruyterbrill.com, researchgate.net — both returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch). conference: Catalysis Society of Japan Annual Meeting (触媒討論会)
method: Rung 1 Japanese search found the 136th 触媒討論会 (Sept 2025, Tohoku University) site — a plain WordPress site (catsj136.infotecs.jp), NOT Confit-hosted despite the general field-notes caution about this society; it opened fine to curl, no browser needed. Downloaded both official programme PDFs (zero further search cost) and counted unique session-codes with pdftotext -layout: oral programme (136_oral_program7.pdf) = 372 coded slots, of which 25 依頼講演 (invited), 6 特別講演 (special/plenary), 4 受賞講演（奨励賞） (award lecture) and 2 講演中止 (cancelled) are excluded, leaving 335 contributed oral talks; poster programme (136_poster-program2.pdf, https://catsj136.infotecs.jp/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/136_poster-program2.pdf) = 111 unique P-numbered posters, all contributed (only a student-award star marker, no invited posters). Total contributed = 335 + 111 = 446, well under the ~900 floor. Language searched: Japanese.

conference: SPSJ Annual Meeting (高分子学会年次大会)
method: Rung 1-2 Japanese searches found the 74th SPSJ Annual Meeting (May 2025, online) but no stated presentation count; main.spsj.or.jp is Shift-JIS per field notes and was not used as the source. Located the countable artefact: 高分子学会予稿集 (Polymer Preprints, Japan), the society's own preprint series, deposited on J-STAGE under journal code 'spsjppj' — confirmed to exist (via Google's index) for at least volumes 51, 51m, 52m, 53, 53m, 58m (bare numeral = SPSJ Annual Meeting; 'm' suffix = the separate SPSJ Symposium on Macromolecules, NOT this row). This is a zero-search deposit-index rung, structurally identical to the Crossref approach used for medicine — each meeting's TOC / entry count is normally visible on the browse page. BLOCKED: J-STAGE's /browse/ URLs return HTTP 404 to bare curl/WebFetch for every volume tried (51, 53, 58m, and 60 through 74 inclusive), even for volumes Google itself has indexed — a bot/JS wall, not evidence the volumes don't exist. Needs rung 5 (real browser) to (1) find J-STAGE's current volume number for the 74th/75th Annual Meeting specifically (the 'volume = meeting number' mapping may have drifted or the deposit may have stopped in recent years), and (2) count TOC entries, subtracting any invited-marked sessions. Language searched: Japanese.
